title: Ranch Dressing’s World Cup Glow Fades With Salad Safety Worries
content:
• Sales of Kraft Heinz Co.’s salad dressings fell 20% and Clorox Co.’s Hidden Valley Ranch dressing fell 5% in the last four weeks, according to TD Cowen analyst Robert Moskow citing Nielsen data.
• The cyclospora outbreak led to iceberg lettuce sales dropping 20% in the last four weeks, impacting the $2.6 billion lettuce category where iceberg lettuce represents about 37%.
• If current sales declines continue for the third calendar quarter, they would represent a 55 basis points drag on Clorox’s US retail sales and 40 basis points on Kraft Heinz’s.

title: Goa moves Supreme Court seeking life term for Tarun Tejpal in 2013 rape case
content:
• The Goa government has approached the Supreme Court seeking to increase former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal's 10-year prison term to life imprisonment in the 2013 rape case.
• The Bombay High Court convicted Tarun Tejpal in the 2013 rape case, sentencing him to 10 years of rigorous imprisonment and imposing a fine of more than ₹10 lakh.
• Tarun Tejpal was initially acquitted by a trial court in May 2021, a verdict that was overturned by the Bombay High Court's conviction on August 6 (earlier this month).

title: State Farm $5 billion dividend — Who qualifies for the payout and what customers need to know
content:
• State Farm is distributing a record $5 billion cash-back dividend to eligible auto insurance customers, marking the largest such payout in its over 100-year history.
• The $5 billion dividend covers more than 49 million qualifying State Farm Mutual auto vehicles, with payments calculated as 4% to 10% of premiums paid for each policy during 2025.
• State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company, a mutual company owned by its policyholders, is led by President and CEO Jon Farney.

title: India's outward FDI jumps 17% to $5.7 billion in July: RBI
content:
• India's outward Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) jumped 17% to $5.7 billion in July, according to the RBI.
• Quest Global Engineering Solutions led equity outflows with $664 million in July, followed by Aster DM Healthcare ($140 million) and Natco Pharma ($108 million).
• ONGC Videsh made the highest loan transfer of $407 million to its Singaporean subsidiary in July.

title: RBI finds cash demand harder to predict as digital payments grow
content:
• RBI Deputy Governor Murmu, at a central bankers' meeting in Jakarta on August 13, stated that predicting cash demand is harder due to growing digital payments amidst double-digit growth in currency in circulation.
• At present, 176 billion banknotes are in circulation in India.
• India annually produced between 28 and 30 billion banknotes across six denominations and disposed of roughly 21 billion pieces a year over the past few years, with the RBI exploring polymer notes for lower denominations to extend their life.

title: RBI measures lift FY27 BoP outlook to over $50 bn surplus, CAD seen at 1%: SBI Research
content:
• According to SBI Research, India's balance of payments (BoP) is expected to post a surplus of around USD 50 billion in FY27, with the current account deficit (CAD) likely to remain contained at 1% of GDP.
• The Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) special FCNR(B) deposit mobilisation scheme has already attracted USD 57 billion in inflows, with total collections projected to reach around USD 85 billion by the end of August.
• Gold's share in India's foreign exchange reserves reached a record 16.7% in FY26 before moderating to 15.38% as of August 7.

title: PM CARES fund rises to ₹8,453 cr in 2024-25, 175% up in 5 years
content:
• The PM CARES fund's total receipts rose to ₹8,452.95 crore in 2024-25, marking a 175% increase over five years from its launch in 2019-20 when it collected ₹3,076.62 crore.
• The audited closing balance of the PM CARES fund on March 31, 2025, stood at ₹8,452.07 crore, representing an 18% increase from ₹7,173.03 crore recorded a year earlier.
• In FY25, ₹7,846.65 crore of the PM CARES fund was parked in fixed deposits, and an additional ₹605.41 crore was held in savings bank accounts.

title: Professionals in India see mismatch between job titles, pay: Report
content:
• Indeed's quarterly hiring tracker report, surveyed by Valuvox in May and June 2026, gathered inputs from 1,211 employers and 2,533 employees across India.
• Nearly 6 in 10 professionals (approximately 60%) reported that their job title does not reflect their compensation, according to the Indeed report.
• Nearly 1 in 3 employees who received a title change over the past two years experienced either no salary increase or an increment of less than 5 per cent.

title: India's CAD may widen in FY27, but capital flows may support Rupee in H2: Report
content:
• India's goods deficit is estimated to increase to $390 billion in FY27.
• India's current account deficit (CAD) remained contained at $6.2 billion in Q1 FY27, bolstered by a 9% YoY rise in services exports to $52.2 billion and a 34% YoY increase in remittances to $41.4 billion.
• FCNR inflows increased to $52.3 billion as of August 13 from $36.7 billion at the end of July, contributing to an estimated overall Balance of Payments (BoP) surplus of ~$55 billion for the year.

title: Why is PM CARES Fund keeping large sums idle, asks RTI activist
content:
• The PM CARES Fund received donations of ₹480 crore and had a total income of ₹1,279.9 crore in 2024-25.
• The closing balance of the PM CARES Fund stood at ₹8,452.06 crore in FY 2024-25, with only ₹87.85 lakh (0.01% of the closing balance) spent during that fiscal year.
• The PM CARES Fund, established in March 2020 and chaired by the Prime Minister, remains outside the ambit of the RTI Act, parliamentary scrutiny, and audit by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG).
